page.overview:
What is Inventor?

The Inventor theme was introduced in 2003. It included sets that involved using motors, wind-up bricks, etc. It was discontinued in 2004.

LEGO made a flash game in 2003 based on the Inventor line of products. The game was called Inventor Saves The Day, and involved using parts from the Inventor theme to solve problems.
